objective: Measure whether Git timing and diff-process evidence adds repository-held-out signal beyond the frozen commit-message proxy without leaking explicit provenance, labels, or identities into model inputs.

label_taxonomy.verified_agent_provenance: The commit contains independently inspectable agent provenance; this evidence is never a model input.
label_taxonomy.agent_reference: The commit lies in a maintainer-attested agent reference window.
label_taxonomy.policy_human_reference: The commit lies in a separately adjudicated AI-ban control window; contamination remains possible.
label_taxonomy.unlabeled: No admissible reference label is assigned.

outcome_taxonomy.verified_agent: Externally inspectable provenance supports direct agent involvement.
outcome_taxonomy.likely_agent_driven: Multiple non-provenance evidence views support agent involvement after held-repository validation.
outcome_taxonomy.hybrid_or_assisted: Evidence supports mixed human and agent involvement or does not justify full-code attribution.
outcome_taxonomy.unknown_or_human_control: Evidence is insufficient for an agent outcome, or the commit belongs to a separately labeled human-control window.

leakage_controls.identity_storage: Author and committer identities are lowercased, repository-scoped, and SHA-256 hashed for audit joins only.

missingness.unavailable_repository: Record the repository ID and exclude it from fitted evaluation.
missingness.missing_gap: Encode a separate missingness indicator and a zero transformed value; do not impute from class labels.

sourcegraph_role: Sourcegraph supplies the frozen sg-evals frame, cutoff-accessible repository mapping, cross-repository candidate discovery, historical commit and diff search, and blame links. Exact full-history timing is mechanically extracted from the corresponding pinned Git object graph; SCIP is not required.
